question: In triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle B=45^\circ\), \(\tan C=3/4\), and the altitude to side \(BC\) is \(AD=6\) (\(D\) lies on segment \(BC\)). Find the length of \(BC\).
solution: Since \(\angle B=45^\circ\), \(BD=AD=6\). From \(\tan C=AD/DC=3/4\), we obtain \(DC=8\). Therefore, \(BC=6+8=14\).
